mapper.select: SELECT FROM knowledge_ingestion WHERE next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (status = 'RECEIVED' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))) AND tenant_id = #{tenant} ORDER BY next_attempt_at, created_at, job_id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_ingestion SET status = 'PROCESSING', stage = CASE WHEN prepared_key IS NULL THEN 'PREPARING' ELSE 'PUBLISHING' END, lease_owner = #{worker}, lease_epoch = lease_epoch + 1, lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{lease}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, revision = revision + 1, error_code = NULL, retryable = FALSE, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE job_id = #{row.jobId} AND tenant_id = #{row.tenantId} AND owner_id = #{row.ownerId} AND lease_epoch = #{row.leaseEpoch} AND next_attempt_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) AND (status = 'RECEIVED' OR (status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until <= UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)))
UPDATE knowledge_ingestion SET lease_until = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{lease}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) WHERE

UPDATE knowledge_ingestion SET prepared_key = #{ref.key}, prepared_hash = #{ref.hash}, prepared_bytes = #{ref.sizeBytes}, batch_digest = #{ref.batchDigest}, stage = 'PUBLISHING', revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE AND prepared_key IS NULL
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO knowledge_chunk (chunk_id, tenant_id, owner_id, document_id, document_version, job_id, batch_digest, ordinal, text, text_hash, start_byte, end_byte, preparation_schema, source_locator, source_json, source_digest, extraction_digest) VALUES
(#{c.chunkId}, #{claim.job.tenantId}, #{claim.job.ownerId}, #{claim.job.documentId}, #{claim.job.documentVersion}, #{claim.job.jobId}, #{doc.batchDigest}, #{c.ordinal}, #{c.text}, #{c.textHash}, #{c.startByte}, #{c.endByte}, #{c.preparationSchema}, #{c.sourceLocator}, CAST(#{c.sourceJson} AS JSON), #{c.sourceDigest}, #{c.extractionDigest})
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_ingestion SET status = 'READY', stage = 'COMPLETE', error_code = NULL, retryable = FALSE, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE AND vector_state = 'DONE' AND keyword_state = 'DONE' AND batch_digest = #{claim.prepared.batchDigest}
UPDATE knowledge_ingestion SET status = 'FAILED', error_code = #{code}, retryable = #{retryable}, lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE

UPDATE knowledge_ingestion SET status = 'RECEIVED', retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_code = NULL, retryable = FALSE, attempt_count = 0, next_attempt_at = TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{delay}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)), revision = revision + 1, updated_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE AND revision = #{revision} AND status = 'FAILED' AND retryable = TRUE AND retry_count < #{maximum}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_ingestion_event (event_id, job_id, actor, action, status, stage, lease_epoch, revision, error_code, created_at) SELECT #{eventId}, job_id, #{actor}, #{action}, status, stage, lease_epoch, revision, error_code, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) FROM knowledge_ingestion WHERE
mapper.sql: FROM knowledge_chunk c JOIN knowledge_document d ON d.document_id = c.document_id AND d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.owner_id = c.owner_id JOIN knowledge_ingestion j ON j.job_id = c.job_id AND j.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND j.owner_id = c.owner_id JOIN knowledge_document_revision r ON r.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND r.owner_id = c.owner_id AND r.document_id = c.document_id AND r.content_revision = c.document_version WHERE c.tenant_id = #{caller.tenantId} AND c.owner_id = #{caller.userId} AND d.lifecycle = 'ACTIVE' AND d.lifecycle_ready = TRUE AND d.published_version = c.document_version AND d.published_job_id = j.job_id AND d.published_generation = j.index_generation AND j.document_id = c.document_id AND j.document_version = c.document_version AND j.content_hash = r.content_hash AND j.status = 'READY' AND j.batch_digest = c.batch_digest AND c.preparation_schema = j.preparation_schema AND c.extraction_digest <=> j.extraction_digest AND j.processor_version IN #{profile}

SELECT c.document_id, c.document_version AS version, c.chunk_id, c.batch_digest, c.text, c.start_byte, c.end_byte, r.display_name, j.content_hash AS source_hash, c.source_locator, c.source_json, c.source_digest, j.extraction_digest
mapper.select: AND c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.document_version = #{version} AND c.chunk_id = #{chunkId}

SELECT c.document_id, c.document_version AS version, j.content_hash AS source_hash, j.content_type, j.preparation_schema, j.processor_version, j.parser_profile, j.extraction_digest, j.extraction_warnings AS warnings_json AND c.document_id = #{documentId} AND c.document_version = #{version} ORDER BY c.ordinal LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM knowledge_ingestion WHERE status = #{status}
